rules.intervention_applied: 2-beat rhythmic vacuum (bars 4 beats 2-3) followed by high fanfare and 808 drop
rules.why_it_worked: Zero phase cancellation (0.0 dB mono loss) preserved punch in collapsed mono environments. Crest factor of 3.8 dB delivered punchy transient impact without master bus squashing. Surprise delta of +35% shattered ear fatigue and lifted emotional energy.
rules.generalizable_rule: When arranging a climax in Eb (Hook 3): applying '2-beat rhythmic vacuum followed by high fanfare and 808 drop' creates high emotional payoff while maintaining mono fidelity.
